description: This file contains a SCSS mixin library for responsive sizing called RFS (Responsive Font Size). It defines variables, functions, and mixins to generate responsive CSS values based on viewport dimensions, supporting features like two-dimensional scaling, breakpoints, and configurable modes.

methods.name: divide
methods.description: Performs division with optional precision handling and unit conversion within SCSS.

methods.name: rfs-value
methods.description: Returns a CSS value string with responsive sizing based on input list of values.

methods.name: rfs-fluid-value
methods.description: Calculates a responsive fluid value that adjusts between minimum and maximum based on viewport size.

methods.name: rfs
methods.description: Main mixin to apply responsive font size or other properties based on input values.
